AMP - My AMP|AMP_ESSENTIAL_HL|RESIDENTIA.description: A variable home loan with no offset facility and no package fees.

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Multiple Security Fee
fees.info: Per security. Payable for each additional security offered at loan establishment. Fee is not refundable.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Valuation fee
fees.info: Payable when valuation costs associated with a loan application or variation exceed $550. If applicable, we will advise you of any excess valuation costs payable prior to the valuation.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Rework fee
fees.info: Payable when a loan agreement or variation to loan agreement is re-issued due to changes requested by either you or the introducer.

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: AMP internal refinance fee
fees.info: Payable on settlement. Payable on settlement where you had an AMP Bank loan immediately before establishment of this loan and that loan was refinanced or otherwise replaced with this loan, either in part or in whole.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Variation fee
fees.info: Plus any solicitor's or mortgage processing costs, valuation costs if applicable and any government fees which may vary from state to state. Payable when we agree to vary your loan or any security - not payable for ProPack or AMP First loans. Switching to a variable rate or another fixed rate at the end of a fixed rate period is free. Switching your repayment type from interest only to principal and interest is free.

fees.label: EXIT
fees.name: Discharge fee
fees.info: Payable when we are requested to discharge all securities. Customers also pay the actual solicitors' or mortgage processing servicers' costs, which include,for example, search fees and postage, valuation costs if applicable and any applicable Government fees, which may vary from state to state.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Verification of identity by Australia Post
fees.info: Payable when you obtain a Verification of Identity service from an Australia Post office.

fees.label: DISHONOUR
fees.name: Payment dishonour fees
fees.info: You may be charged a fee by an external bank or financial institution for a transaction relating to your loan (eg. if a payment to your loan made from another bank is dishonoured, the other bank may charge you a fee).

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Solicitors and mortgage processing servicers' cost
fees.info: Whenever a new loan agreement is established and we instruct our solicitors or mortgage processing servicers' to act on our behalf in connection with this agreement or a security.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Solicitors' and mortgage processing servicers' incidental costs

fees.label: EVENT

features.label: REDRAW
features.info: Redraw applies to AMP Bank variable rate home loans only. You can access extra funds you’ve deposited at any time, with no withdrawal fees when using online banking, the AMP app, BankPhone or BankAssist. Minimum amounts and daily limits may apply.

features.label: EXTRA_REPAYMENTS
features.info: AMP home loans allow for flexible additional repayments to reduce interest and pay off loans faster. Variable rate loans allow unlimited extra repayments, while fixed-rate loans often limit these to $10,000 per 12-month period. Please refer to Loan Conditions and Credit guide for more information on the consequences of repaying your Fixed Rate Loan early

features.label: ADDITIONAL_CARDS
features.info: Additional cards can be requested.

features.label: FRAUD_PROTECTION
features.info: AMP home loans are protected by secure login, encryption, transaction monitoring, and customer alerts to help prevent and detect fraud. Support is available for customers in the event of suspected unauthorised activity.

features.label: GUARANTOR
features.info: AMP Bank home loans allow eligible applicants to use a guarantor, typically a close family member who provides additional security for the loan. This can help customers who have a limited deposit or may not meet standard lending criteria. Guarantor eligibility is subject to AMP Bank’s lending requirements and the guarantor’s financial position.

eligibility.label: RESIDENCY_STATUS
eligibility.info: Individual borrowers must be Permanent residents or citizens of Australia, All new to bank customers must be living and working in Australia

eligibility.label: MIN_AGE
eligibility.info: Eligible customers must be at least 18 years of age

eligibility.label: NATURAL_PERSON
eligibility.info: The customer must be a natural person rather than another legal entity. Some AMP Bank home loan products are available to eligible legal entities, such as companies and trusts, subject to AMP Bank’s lending criteria. These loans are generally offered under specific products like the Professional Package, and are not available under all home loan offerings.

constraints.label: MIN_LIMIT
constraints.info: Minimum lending amount for new home loans is $250,000

constraints.label: OTHER
constraints.info: The loan term ranges from a minimum of 10 years to a maximum of 30 years

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Break costs
fees.info: Payable if at any time before the fixed interest period expires: You make additional repayments above the minimum required payments exceeding $10,000 for each 12 month period within a fixed interest period; or You repay all of the money owing under the facility during any fixed interest period before it is due; or We agree to change your annual percentage rate during your fixed interest period (this includes a change to your annual percentage ratedue to a change to your repayment type [principal andinterest or interest only] or a change to your loan purpose [owner occupied or investment]). Break costs can be substantial. The amount which is our estimate of loss (if any) resulting from the relevant event. A 12 month period is defined as the time from the date the fixed interest period commenced to the initial anniversary of that date and each consecutive anniversary thereafter until the fixed interest period expires. Refer to your Loan Conditions for more information.

ANZ|3a86f9e4-1b41-4222-9091-5934d1fc9178.description: Our fixed rate home loan gives you the certainty of knowing what your repayments will be during the fixed period. ANZ Fixed Home Loans are available for periods between of at least 1 year and up to 30 years in duration.

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Loan Approval Fee
fees.info: We will not charge a Loan Approval Fee/Facility Approval Fee in respect to the establishment of your new loan/facility. Please refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Valuation Administration Fee
fees.info: We will not charge a Valuation Administration Fee for any valuations we undertake on properties relating to the establishment of your loan/facility. Refer to the ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Guarantee Administration Fee
fees.info: We will not charge a Guarantee Administration Fee where a guarantee is taken by us for the purpose of securing your loan/facility. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: PERIODIC
fees.name: Loan Administration Charge
fees.info: We will not charge a monthly Loan Administration Charge for your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Renegotiation Fee (Non Credit Critical)
fees.info: We will not charge a Renegotiation Fee or a further Loan Approval Fee/Facility Approval Fee if we approve an application by you to renegotiate or convert your loan/facility. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Late Payment Fee
fees.info: Charged when a payment remains unpaid for 30 days or more after it is due. A further fee is payable monthly when the loan continues to be in arrears. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Lock Rate Fee
fees.info: This fee is payable if you'd like to lock in the interest rate at the time of your application for up to 90 days. The Lock Rate fee will be $750 for every $1M of lending. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Lodgement Fee
fees.info: Payable for each document that ANZ lodges or registers with any person or authority in respect of your loan or any security provided for your loan, where ANZ is required or entitled to lodge or register that document. This fee is not charged on establishment of your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Production Fee
fees.info: Payable for each Certificate or Title or other security document ANZ produces at your request, in connection with your loan. This fee is not charged on establishment of your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Settlement Fee
fees.info: Payable each time that ANZ is required to attend a settlement (or attend to an electronic settlement) in relation to any advance made under your Loan, or in relation to any securities provided or varied in respect of your Loan. The fee is payable on the date of the settlement and is not dependent on the settlement being successful. This fee is not charged on establishment of your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Search Fee
fees.info: Payable each time that ANZ obtains information from governmental or regulatory records in connection with the loan/facility or any security. This fee is not charged on establishment of your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Renegotiation Fee (Full Credit Critical)
fees.info: We will not charge a Renegotiation Fee or a further Loan Approval Fee/Facility Approval Fee if we approve an application by you to renegotiate or convert your loan/facility. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Progress Payment fee
fees.info: We will not charge a Progress Payment Fee for any progressively drawn loans. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Early Repayment Cost
fees.info: You may have to pay this if you pay your loan off in full, make an early or extra repayment, or make certain other changes to your loan, during any fixed-rate period. This is calculated specifically related to the individual event. More details and method of calculation are given in the ANZ Consumer Lending Terms and Conditions booklet under the heading 'Repaying your loan early or making other changes to your loan during a fixed interest rate period'. This booklet can be found on anz.com.

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Lenders Mortgage Insurance
fees.info: Lenders Mortgage Insurance protects your lender in the event that you default on your home loan and there is a 'shortfall'. A shortfall happens when the proceeds from the sale of your home are not enough to cover the outstanding amount you owe to your lender. If your loan with ANZ requires LMI, ANZ will arrange it and will tell you the cost of the premium and any additional information that may be required. You may also be charged stamp duty, depending on the State or Territory where the security property for your loan is located.

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Stamp Duty - Mortgage Document
fees.info: Generally, stamp duty and other fees are normally payable at settlement when purchasing a new property. The amount is determined by the state or territory revenue office.

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Stamp Duty - Transfer Land
fees.info: Generally, stamp duty and other fees are normally payable at settlement when purchasing a new property. The amount is determined by the state or territory revenue office.

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Enforcement expenses
fees.info: Expenses payable in the event of default. You will be required to pay expenses reasonably incurred by ANZ in enforcing or preserving its rights under your agreement or any security interest provided to ANZ in connection with your agreement. These expenses include those incurred by ANZ in preserving or maintaining property secured, collection expenses and expenses resulting from dishonour of a cheque or payment. Enforcement expenses may be debited in the same way as other fees and charges.

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Other Services
fees.info: If we deal with, vary or supplement our security documentation to comply with your requirements, we may charge a fee. An estimate of the fee can be provided once your specific requirements have been ascertained. Please refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Registration of Mortgage
fees.info: Payable to the government body when registering a mortgage over a property. Refer to the relevant state/territory revenue office for the amount.

fees.label: OTHER
fees.name: Discharge of Mortgage
fees.info: Payable to the government body when discharging an existing mortgage over a property. Refer to the relevant state/territory revenue office for the amount.

features.label: OFFSET
features.info: With an ANZ One offset account, you could offset the amount you owe on your one-year fixed rate home loan and you'll only be charged interest on the difference.

features.label: DIGITAL_BANKING
features.info: Access using ANZ Internet Banking or ANZ App

features.label: REDRAW
features.info: Not available during fixed rate period. Once your loan reverts to the Standard Variable Rate, the redraw option may be available to allow you access to additional repayments you may have made to your loan.

features.label: CASHBACK_OFFER
features.info: If you're buying your first home, you could get $3,000 to spend however you like, plus support from an ANZ First Home Coach. Available to eligible first home buyers with an ANZ home loan of $250,000 or more. Drawdown within 180 days of applying, bonus paid after settlement. Eligibility criteria and T&Cs apply.

features.label: EXTRA_REPAYMENTS
features.info: You can make extra repayments up to a set available tolerance amount (the lesser of 5% of the loan amount at the start of the fixed rate period or $5,000) in each year of the fixed rate period. If the total fixed rate period is less than a year, the tolerance amount is reduced proportionally. If you choose to make additional repayments above this tolerance amount, repay your fixed rate loan (in part or in full), with our consent, or switch to a new fixed interest rate or variable interest rate before the end of your fixed rate period, change the term of the current fixed interest rate period of your loan or change certain terms of your loan, you may have to pay an early repayment cost.

eligibility.label: MIN_AGE
eligibility.info: You must be 18 years of age or older to apply

eligibility.label: RESIDENCY_STATUS
eligibility.value: Australian citizens, New Zealand citizens or Australian permanent residents

eligibility.label: OTHER
eligibility.info: Applicant's primary income is in Australian Dollars

constraints.label: MIN_LIMIT
constraints.info: Minimum loan amount is $20,000

fees.label: UPFRONT
fees.name: Establishment fee
fees.info: Payable to cover the costs the Bank incurs in establishing your loan and unless it is waived by us, is payable at the date of settlement or funding. It does not include other fees and charges also payable at the time of entering into the loan such as those associated with the settlement of the loan or the particular circumstances of the loan.

fees.label: PERIODIC
fees.name: Loan Service Fee
fees.info: Charged monthly to each Loan Account on the repayment due date.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Settlement Cheque Fee
fees.info: $30 per cheque. Payable if you require additional cheques (more than two) to fund / settle the loan.

fees.label: LATE_PAYMENT
fees.name: Late Payment Fee
fees.info: For home loans - If your account falls into arrears, you will be charged a late payment fee. This fee is payable on the fifth business day after the monthly repayment due date. We will continue to charge the fee monthly until you repay all arrears or you enter into an arrangement with us for the full repayment of those arrears (even if you repay your loan weekly or fortnightly). If you break that arrangement the fee will continue to apply.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Paper Statement Fee
fees.info: Payable if you opt out of electronic statements and request bi-annual paper statements, ask us to print a statement or provide you with an ad-hoc paper statement.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Settlement Fee (Discharge)
fees.info: Payable if you discharge the loan, i.e. either sell part or all of the Security Property or refinance your Loan with another credit provider.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Security Substitution fee
fees.info: Payable if you ask us to substitute one of your securities with another.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Stop payment notice fee
fees.info: Payable if you ask us to stop payment on a cheque you have written.

fees.label: ENQUIRY
fees.name: Voucher Fee
fees.info: $4 per voucher (minimum charge $12) or $60 per hour spent to retrieve voucher(s). Payable if you ask us to retrieve a voucher (i.e. deposit, credit or debit slips) that records a transaction on the Loan Account.

fees.label: PERIODIC
fees.name: Offset Feature fee
fees.info: Payable monthly on the repayment due date if an Everyday Offset account is or has been linked to the Loan Account on any day during the repayment period.

fees.label: EVENT
fees.name: Switching Fee
fees.info: Payable when switching your loan purpose, repayment type or product type.

features.label: EXTRA_REPAYMENTS
features.info: You can make unlimited additional repayments (including the ability to pay the loan out early) without additional charge.

features.label: REDRAW
features.info: Unlimited fee free redraw when done online through CommBank App or NetBank.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: You can switch your loan or repayment type, for example switching from a Digi Home Loan to a Standard Variable Rate or a Fixed Rate home loan or switch from Principal and Interest repayments to Interest Only payments.

features.label: DIGITAL_BANKING
features.info: Wherever you are in the world, CommBank gives you the choice and control to securely manage all of your accounts on a range of devices, the way you want.

features.label: DIGITAL_BANKING
features.info: Easily apply in minutes and download the CommBank app to proceed and manage your home loan online.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: This loan can be used for the purposes of purchases, refinancing your existing home loan from other financial institution, personal needs (e.g. home renovations, consolidation of personal debt) and personal investments other than cryptocurrency or digital assets.

features.label: OTHER
features.info: This loan cannot be used for business purposes, off the plan purchases, purchase of land, building and construction loans or bridging loans.

features.label: OFFSET
features.info: An Everyday Offset account is a transaction account that's linked to your Digi Home Loan or Investment home loan. Any money you put into your Everyday Offset account (e.g. your salary and savings) - whether its $2 or $20,000 - reduces the balance on which we charge interest. This means you'll only be paying interest on the difference. You can have up to one Everyday Offset account linked to one Digi Home Loan. A monthly Offset Feature fee applies. Only available for individual borrowers, not companies or trusts.

features.label: BONUS_REWARDS
features.info: Earn up to 300,000 Qantas Points with a new CommBank Digi Home Loan. Submit between 29 April 2026 and 30 June 2026 inclusive and settle by 28 September 2026 to be eligible for the Qantas Points offer. Available online only. Minimum LVR, loan amount and other conditions apply.

eligibility.label: OTHER

eligibility.label: OTHER

fees.info: If your deposit is less than 20% then Lenders Mortgage Insurance is usually required. There may be other circumstances where Lenders Mortgage Insurance is also required. As Lenders Mortgage Insurance reduces bank's risk as a lender when providing a home loan, you may be able to apply for a home loan and get into your home sooner, with a lower deposit. Lenders Mortgage Insurance insures bank for any shortfall in the event that you default on your loan and if the proceeds from the property sale are not enough to pay off the loan in full. The cost of Lenders Mortgage Insurance is calculated as a percentage of the loan amount. The percentage applied will vary depending on a number of factors. Please speak to your lender if you would like to understand this process in more detail. The cost of Lenders Mortgage Insurance premium is passed on to you. We do not receive a commission on Lenders Mortgage Insurance.
